outputs.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW are shown as scatter/bar plots with individual mouse data points (black circles for NC, red squares for HFD) overlaid on the mean ± SD.
This is a photograph of gross mouse anatomy, not a plot of averaged data.
This panel consists of micrograph images (H&E and Oil Red O staining), not a plot of averaged data.
This panel shows a dot blot and methylene blue staining image, not a plot of averaged data.
The 5mC/methylene blue quantification bar chart displays individual data points (dots) for each of the n=5 samples per group, overlaid on the mean ± SD bars.

The western blot images do not require individual data points, but the bottom quantification bar chart (TET1/TET2/TET3 ratios over GAPDH) shows individual data points (circles/squares) for each animal overlaid on the mean ± SD bars.
